hypothesis: Canonical U16BE NNCP symbols are better modeled by cmix21 no-preprocessing mode than forced English text mode, and eliminating the cmix dictionary saves 175381 counted package bytes without compromising exact reconstruction.
kill_condition: Retire unchanged on any reconstruction or determinism failure, package size above 710000 bytes, archive degradation that consumes the fixed package saving under full-scope projection, or non-positive matched distant total.
promotion_condition: Pass exact 250K roundtrip and deterministic re-encode, then beat the text-mode parent in complete counted score on matched opening 1M and remain positive on a frozen distant window before any 10M promotion.
retired_neighborhoods: forced-text mode tuning on the identical U16BE stream
uncounted removal of either transmitted NNCP dictionary or cmix package dictionary
title: Dictionary-free binary backend for NNCP symbols
